models._description: Form fields of inside quotation documents.

behavioral_notes.observation: A quotation.document is a reusable header/footer PDF block: it delegates storage to ir.attachment via _inherits and carries a document_type selection ('header'|'footer'), a sequence and an add_by_default flag. It is linked to sale.order.template through the shared Many2many relation 'header_footer_quotation_template_rel' (declared on both quotation.document.quotation_template_ids and sale.order.template.quotation_document_ids), so a quotation template owns a curated set of header/footer blocks. On the sale.order, _compute_available_quotation_document_ids restricts the pool to documents of the order's company whose quotation_template_ids is empty (global) or contains the order's template; _onchange_sale_order_template_id then drops documents no longer available and re-adds the template's add_by_default header/footer blocks. This is the 'assemble reusable PDF blocks onto a quotation' behaviour and lives entirely in Python, not metadata.

When a PDF's datas changes, quotation.document._compute_form_field_ids and product.document._compute_form_field_ids call sale.pdf.form.field._create_or_update_form_fields_on_pdf_records, which extracts the AcroForm text-field names from the PDF (utils._get_form_fields_from_pdf) and links one sale.pdf.form.field per field name (deduplicated per document_type by the UNIQUE(name, document_type) constraint). Each form field has an optional 'path': a dotted ORM path validated by _check_valid_and_existing_paths to be a real traversable field chain on sale.order (for quotation_document) or sale.order.line (for product_document). A field WITHOUT a path is a 'customizable' field whose value the user types in the quotation form (stored in sale.order.customizable_pdf_form_fields JSON); a field WITH a path is 'dynamic' and is resolved from live sale.order values at render. _add_basic_mapped_form_fields seeds the standard mappings (e.g. amount_total->amount_total, order_date->date_order, partner_id__name->partner_id.name, quantity->product_uom_qty). Header/footer field names may not start with 'sol_id_' (reserved as the per-line prefix).

The override fires only for report_name == 'sale.report_saleorder'. For each order (skipped once state=='sale' unless the ICP sale.always_include_selected_documents is set) it builds a pypdf PdfFileWriter and merges, in order: each selected header quotation.document, then per order_line each selected product.document, then the original QWeb quotation stream, then each footer. Every added page's AcroForm fields are renamed with a per-document prefix (quotation_document_id_<id>__ for headers/footers, sol_id_<line>_product_document_id_<doc>__ for product docs) via _add_pages_to_writer so identically-named fields across merged PDFs do not collide, and each field is forced read-only + multiline through /Ff flag bit-twiddling. A form_fields_values_mapping of prefixed-name -> value is accumulated and applied at the end with odoo.tools.pdf.fill_form_fields_pdf. This is the actual final-quotation PDF merge/assembly step.

_update_mapping_and_add_pages_to_writer resolves each form field: a path field is filled by _get_value_from_path, which sudo-mapped-traverses the dotted path from the order (or order_line for product docs), formats the leaf by field type (booleans -> Yes/No, monetary -> format_amount with the order currency, date/datetime -> localized to the partner/user timezone, selection -> label, x2many/m2o -> comma-joined display_name), joining multiple values with ', '. A customizable (path-less) field is filled by _get_custom_value_from_order, reading the per-document value the user entered in sale.order.customizable_pdf_form_fields (keyed header/footer/line -> document id -> custom_form_fields). This is the dynamic substitution that fills the PDF AcroForm fields from live sale.order values at render time.

5 JS files, 3 XML templates, 2 OWL components and 0 patches. CustomContentKanbanLikeWidget (registered as view_widget customContentKanbanLikeWidget, template sale_pdf_quote_builder.CustomContentKanbanLike) is an in-form configurator on the sale.order: on setup/effect it calls sale.order.get_update_included_pdf_params via ORM to fetch available headers/lines/footers and their customizable fields, lets the salesperson toggle which header/footer/product PDF blocks are included and type values for path-less (customizable) form fields, then writes back quotation_document_ids (x2ManyCommands) and customizable_pdf_form_fields JSON; it goes readonly once the order state is 'sale'. CustomFieldCard renders an individual customizable form field. Also a custom quotation_document_kanban view/controller and a quotation_document_many2many field widget. Backend-only bundle (web.assets_backend); no external HTTP/SDK/api-key usage (gap #7 empty).

it_architecture.application: sale_pdf_quote_builder (rich-PDF quotation assembly add-on on the Sales app; auto_install on sale_management)
information_flows: depends: sale_management (-> sale -> account, mail, portal)
side-effect: quotation.document/product.document datas change -> _create_or_update_form_fields_on_pdf_records extracts AcroForm field names -> sale.pdf.form.field records
side-effect: sale.order._onchange_sale_order_template_id -> add template add_by_default header/footer blocks, drop unavailable ones
side-effect: OWL configurator get_update_included_pdf_params -> writes quotation_document_ids + customizable_pdf_form_fields JSON
side-effect: ir.actions.report._render_qweb_pdf_prepare_streams (sale.report_saleorder) -> pypdf-merge headers + product docs + quote + footers, prefix & fill AcroForm fields from order/line values

capabilities: Attach Product PDF Documents Inside Quotations
Map PDF AcroForm Fields to Sale Order Data (dynamic & customizable)
value_streams: Quotation document enrichment: define header/footer & product PDF blocks -> attach to template/quotation -> salesperson selects blocks & fills customizable fields -> render merged, form-filled PDF quotation
policies: 1 record rule: quotation.document multi-company scoping (company_id false or parent_of company_ids)
constraint: only non-encrypted PDF mimetypes accepted as header/footer/inside-quote documents
constraint: form-field name alphanumerics/-/_ only, header/footer names may not start with 'sol_id_', UNIQUE(name, document_type)
constraint: form-field path must be a valid traversable ORM field chain on sale.order / sale.order.line
config: ICP sale.always_include_selected_documents forces document inclusion even after order confirmation
stakeholders: Customer (res.partner, receives the rendered PDF quotation)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: sale_pdf_quote_builder is a sales-document enrichment add-on on the Quote-to-Cash value chain: it does not create a new downstream document but enriches the sale.order quotation primary deliverable with reusable header/footer and product PDF blocks merged via pypdf and AcroForm fields filled from live order data. It sits in the Marketing & Sell primary activity (APQC 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services, quotation/proposal management, supporting 3.5.3.13 present quote / 3.5.3.14 revise quote). It auto-installs on sale_management and operates at quotation-render time, so its value-creation logic is the linear, document-producing transformation characteristic of a value chain rather than a shop/network/support model.

standard_capabilities: reusable header/footer PDF blocks (quotation.document) attachable to quotation templates and quotations
product-level PDF documents merged inside the quotation PDF (attached_on_sale='inside')
automatic extraction of PDF AcroForm fields and mapping to sale order / line data via dotted ORM paths
customizable (free-text) form fields the salesperson fills in the quotation form
in-form OWL configurator to toggle included documents and enter field values
render-time pypdf assembly: headers + product docs + quote table + footers with per-document field prefixing and read-only fill
default header/footer inclusion (add_by_default) and multi-company scoping
typical_fits: branded quotations with standard cover pages, terms and back-page blocks
auto-filling contract/specification PDFs with order totals, dates, partner and line data
attaching product datasheets/spec PDFs inside the customer-facing quote
common_gaps: non-text AcroForm widgets (checkboxes, radio, images, signatures) beyond read-only text fill
conditional/rule-based block selection (e.g. block depends on product mix, region or channel)
encrypted/password-protected source PDFs are rejected (must be pre-decrypted)
non-PDF formats (docx/xlsx) cannot be merged inside the quote
drive_hints: odoo shell: so.get_update_included_pdf_params()  # headers/lines/footers offered to the OWL configurator

open_questions: Precedence/merge order when both a per-company default header and a template-supplied header carry add_by_default and apply to the same order.
How dynamic path values are localized when the order partner timezone differs from the rendering user (tz fallback chain partner->user->UTC).
Behaviour when a customizable field value is left blank vs a dynamic path resolving to an empty value (both yield '' but differ in source/auditability).
